structured.title: High vibration on Compressor Train CT-301A — bearing degradation suspected
structured.summary: Vibration readings on CT-301A have exceeded the 7.5 mm/s alarm threshold for the third consecutive 6-hour window. Trend analysis shows progressive RMS increase from 5.2 to 9.4 mm/s over 72 hours, consistent with early-stage bearing degradation in the drive-end position. Seal oil pressure has remained stable, ruling out seal-path contribution.
hypothesis: Drive-end bearing degradation on CT-301A is the primary cause of progressive vibration increase, consistent with inner-race defect frequency signature in the 72-hour trend.
Lubrication degradation may be accelerating wear — last oil analysis showed elevated iron particulate at 18 ppm vs 8 ppm baseline.
root_causes: Inner-race bearing defect progressing on drive-end position of CT-301A
Possible lubrication degradation contributing to accelerated wear rate
contributing_factors: Extended run since last scheduled bearing inspection (147 days vs 120-day interval)
Ambient temperature increase of 8°C over the past week may have reduced lubricant viscosity margin
immediate_actions: Schedule vibration spectrum analysis on CT-301A drive-end bearing within the next shift
Collect oil sample from CT-301A bearing housing for expedited particulate analysis
Review compressor performance curves for capacity derating if vibration exceeds 11 mm/s
pm_suggestions: Create planned work order for CT-301A drive-end bearing replacement during the next available maintenance window
Add CT-301A to the 90-day bearing inspection cycle to prevent recurrence
Schedule lubricant flush and refill with high-temperature synthetic grade for the compressor train

repair_plan.summary: Replace drive-end bearing assembly on CT-301A compressor train
repair_plan.rationale: Progressive vibration trend and elevated iron particulate indicate bearing degradation that will lead to unplanned shutdown if not addressed within the next 2-3 weeks.
repair_plan.permit_type: Hot work permit required for compressor isolation

procedure_steps.action: Isolate CT-301A from process gas and depressurize per LOTO procedure CT-301-ISO
procedure_steps.safety_note: Verify zero energy state before proceeding

procedure_steps.action: Remove coupling guard and disconnect drive coupling
procedure_steps.safety_note: Use proper rigging for coupling weight

procedure_steps.action: Remove drive-end bearing cap and extract bearing assembly
procedure_steps.safety_note: Retain old bearing for failure analysis

procedure_steps.action: Inspect shaft journal and housing bore for scoring or damage
Install new bearing with proper preload per OEM specification
procedure_steps.safety_note: Use induction heater — do not direct-flame heat bearing

procedure_steps.action: Reassemble, align coupling, and perform post-maintenance vibration check

safety_requirements: Hot work permit for compressor bay
